Document.Paragraph: Build homes near this stop and jobs near another stop on the same connected network. Buses use roads, railway stations use rails; underground and elevated stations use their matching track layer. Staff and supplies are required. Open Transport report for ridership and operating costs.
Document.p: Underground stations have a square walking catchment extending 20 tiles from each edge. Underground rails can touch any side or pass beneath a station. Railway and elevated stations can share the underground line where it reaches their footprint. Stations require workers and electricity.
